Founder Alex discusses hitting product-market fit with 50+ streamers and dozens of sponsors, launching Coinbase wallet integration and X.42 payment protocol to automate sponsor matching, and kicking off token buyback-and-burn this week.

topics.text: Pyro solves creator monetization by letting brands sponsor streamers through token burns rather than traditional ads.
50+ Pump Fun streamers and 37 sponsors using Pyro, collectively representing $2-3M in token market cap and 2-3K concurrent viewers.
Carl Vogel earning $1,000 per stream from sponsorship burns on Pyro, with sponsors spending up to $1,000 per episode.
Pyro launching Coinbase embedded wallets and X.42 stablecoin payments to let sponsors specify marketing spend and automatically allocate across streamers.
Kickoff of buyback-and-burn flywheel for Pyro token this week, using protocol revenue from sponsor fees.
Clips represent ~90% of aggregate viewership for live streams; Pyro partnering with LiveSuite to track impressions via unique hashtags.
Trading platforms and trading tools spending the most on sponsorships, with strong natural synergy to Pump Fun streamer audiences.
Pump Fun has 6,000 streamers now but lacks stream discovery; Pyro building categories and sorting mechanisms that Pump could eventually acquire.
Speculation that Nikita Bear's public wallet triggered a Pyro price breakout about a week prior, pulling in new whale interest.

jvn-CbwG-8A.tldr: Loaf discusses DREAM, a platform building AI agent commerce infrastructure on top of X42, a micropayment protocol that allows payments via HTTP. He argues X42 could fundamentally reshape global commerce by enabling transactions as cheap as fractions of a cent, and that integrating stablecoin wallets into ChatGPT and Claude could bring 900 million users into crypto—vastly larger than crypto's current 40-50 million weekly active users.

topics.text: Founder spent years building fully on-chain games on Arbitrum and Starknet, discovering EVM limitations led him toward Starknet's larger computational scope via zero-knowledge technology.
X42 allows payments through HTTP by having buyers sign a message with their wallet, sellers verify funds, and facilitators settle the transaction for a fraction of a cent on Base.

X42 could reduce merchant payment fees from 1.5-3% of revenue to near-zero, potentially enabling micropayments for resources like market analysis (10 cents), macro analysis (1 dollar), or trading signals (1 cent).

Weekly active users of ChatGPT and Claude total 900 million versus 40-50 million for crypto; if these platforms integrate stablecoin wallets natively, it would instantly bring 900 million people on-chain with X42 access.

DREAM's product suite includes Daydreams agent framework, Lucid for managing agent profit-and-loss, Dream Router as an LLM inference provider via X42, and Xgate as an agentic search engine for X42 resources.

DREAM token revenue from the Router generates buybacks; founder rejects need for 100-million-token launches per agent, instead emphasizing value accrual to projects solving genuine builder and consumer problems.

Number of sellers and buyers are the most important X42 adoption metrics, not transaction volume, because volume can be artificially inflated with large single transactions whereas micropayments will be numerous but small.

Founder's vision: convert hundreds of millions globally—including farmers in Philippines and emerging economies—into X42 resource builders earning $50+ per resource without extracting or gaming value.
ChatGPT integrating X42 natively would be the largest onboarding event into crypto ever; founder notes OpenAI already has partnerships with Stripe and Coinbase, signaling inevitability.

uYPkr8oirf8.tldr: Moby is an AI-powered discovery and trading app for Solana tokens that launched a mobile app two weeks ago, now at 33,000 users. Founder Matteas discusses how their smart money algorithm differentiates them from Dex Screener, their decision to stay on Pump Fun as an ICM token rather than migrate, and their ambitious vision to become "Robin Hood onchain" by expanding beyond memecoins to include stocks, RWAs, and other assets with 50% of fees going toward Moby token buybacks.

topics.text: The mobile app launched two weeks ago and exceeded expectations with over 30,000 users, exceeding Dex Screener-like growth metrics.
Whale Watch started as a Twitter feed within Acid Dash after users complained about coin discovery problems; the X team noted it was growing faster than any crypto account had before.
Moby's trending algorithm ranks coins by smart money wallet activity rather than paid rankings, making it ungameable unlike Dex Screener's system where users can pay for top placement.
50% of upgrade fees from Moby Mobile and Screener go to buying back the Moby token, with treasury and rewards as the two current destinations for buybacks.
Decided not to migrate from Pump Fun to another chain because migration introduced community complexity and time-based risks, similar to the Believe migration that caused user losses.
The screener TAM includes Dex Screener's 1.5 million-plus monthly upgrade revenue, but the larger opportunity is the swap TAM where Phantom does 300,000-400,000 in daily trading fees.
Planning to launch on another chain before end of year with trending algorithm, whale watch, and smart money development already underway; announcement coming later this month.
The progress bar requires 100K MOI before claiming rewards, sized so buyback volume significantly exceeds reward distributions to prevent sell pressure.

_QsM6dcOfjc.tldr: SOAR launches Impulser, a contactless power transfer company, as its first curated project using a novel debt-structuring model where 6% of tokens circulate as senior debt against the company, with 94% locked for three months. Tom from SOAR explains the tokenomics, why this model aligns founder and token holder incentives, and discusses the massive market opportunity in wireless energy transmission.

topics.text: Token structure: 5% available for trading, 5% for project growth, 90% locked for three months; companies can claim unlocked tokens after three months with 72-hour disclosure notice to holders.
Impulser's technology: contactless power transfer (CPT) using radio frequency, optical lasers, and magnetic resonance to transmit energy through air without wires or cables.
Live demo: wireless charging field embedded in a table powers a coaster and drone without contact, showing three-dimensional charging capability within defined boundaries.
Patrick Sang's background: listed Fubo TV on NYSE for $2.5 billion in 2020, turned $30 million Pulse Evolution investment into $3 billion through mergers, made 300x return in two years.

Impulser's market focus: targeting industrial and government contracts first due to higher budgets, then consumer goods like drones, robots, warehouses, and eventually electric vehicles charging in motion.
Fee structure: SOAR takes 1% of volume, Impulser receives 1% of volume from token trading; founders are not funding-constrained and chose SOAR to democratize early-stage investment access.
Tokenomics explained: 6% circulating supply represents senior debt against Impulser; company benefits from buybacks (debt reduction) but pays cost for unlocking additional tokens (debt increase).
True market cap is approximately $1.3 million, not $21 million displayed, since only 6% circulating supply represents actual company debt against full enterprise value.

SOAR's model: interest-free debt callable only on liquidity events (IPO, acquisition, merger); companies can reduce debt by buying back tokens on open market, aligning token holder success with company profitability.
Future vision: Tom expects legislation allowing equity on-chain by end of 2026; SOAR positioned to flip existing debt tokens to equity tokens if regulatory environment changes.
SOAR token: not launching in immediate future; upcoming platform incentives for trading and holding will encourage longer-term aligned users without belief score mechanic.
Launch cadence: targeting one curated launch per week to maintain quality signal; five to ten day spacing allows internal review and prevents dilution of 'curated' badge meaning.

Gz9J2YcBIyM.tldr: SmartPracticeAI is an AI medical scribe for dental practices that transcribes patient notes and handles documentation, saving doctors 2-3 hours daily. Founder Mike discusses generating $22,870 in monthly recurring revenue in one week through a Dentrix integration partnership with Henry Shine (a Fortune 500 company with 90% dental market penetration), with enterprise customers choosing to pay in $SMRT tokens to unlock additional AI features like automated patient intake.

topics.text: SmartPracticeAI generated $22,870 monthly recurring revenue in a single week since Dentrix integration, with approximately $10,000 from direct token buybacks from enterprise customers.
Closed 25 enterprise contracts in one week from Florida Dental Convention leads after Dentrix integration went live; 25 customers comprise over 100 total users at $99 per month per user.
Customers who pay in SMRT tokens gain access to an AI patient intake coordinator that handles check-ins, appointment confirmations, and insurance verification.
Dentrix is the number one dental practice management software in the United States with roughly 90% market penetration; owned by Henry Shine (Fortune 500, $12.7 billion annual revenue in 2024).
Token payment process currently requires manual steps: customers sign up, then receive email instructions to download Phantom wallet and buy SMRT; founder acknowledges this is not yet frictionless.
SmartPracticeAI has an official integration partnership with Epic (verified on X), providing access to over 67,000 healthcare practices and organizations.

Attending Greater New York Dental Conference (November 30-December 3) with professional booth setup expecting 30,000 attendees; projects adding 50,000-100,000 annualized recurring revenue from the event.

Strategy to target enterprise hospital contracts involves selling to middlemen who write RFPs (requests for proposals), positioning SmartPracticeAI as the automatic choice for large hospital systems seeking dental practice management solutions.

PYGTJdBEqFA.tldr: Wonder is building Wonderooth, an open-source alternative to Privy's embedded wallet infrastructure that costs significantly less (charging based on actual infrastructure costs rather than per-MAU fees) and operates on a siloed, privacy-first architecture. The founder, returning for a second interview, claims Wonder can undercut Privy's pricing while offering the same core functionality of creating instant wallets for users via social login, with the added benefit of being deployable on developers' own servers to build enterprise trust.

topics.text: Wonder is transitioning from a website builder (Wonder Sites) into a collective of companies under one token, similar to Alphabet's structure, with Wonderooth as the main product.
Wonderooth is a competitor to Privy that creates embedded wallets instantly when users log in via social accounts (Google, Facebook, GitHub) without requiring browser extension wallets.
Privy's embedded wallets are called disposable wallets and present security risks because if users lose their Google account or if someone gains PC access, the associated funds are lost.
Wonder deploys Wonderooth on a siloed system where each integration gets its own isolated deployment, so if Wonder goes down the client's website and wallet infrastructure remain unaffected.
Wonder is planning to make Wonderooth both open-source and closed-source; developers can deploy their own version on GitHub or their own server without depending on Wonder's infrastructure.
Privy's value comes from holding 75 million wallets and Stripe paid $1.1 billion partially for these user accounts; Privy charges per monthly active users at rates developers find too expensive.

Believe plans to strategically deploy retroactive fees to buy back the token this week, though not all accumulated retroactive fees at once.

topics.text: Founder Ferris started coding at age 14 and has built primarily personal projects, with Lumen being his first major product after starting as a GitHub open-source client.

Lumen's core system grades uploaded code on clarity (uniqueness compared to other projects), architecture (code structure), and quality (code writing effort), with AI generating keywords for buyers to filter projects.
Web uploads pay developers less than client uploads, which allow developers to selectively choose which code to submit and skip parts if desired.

Target demand side includes companies needing code to train AI models, researchers, labs fine-tuning specialized models, and individual students finding code they can't locate online via Payi integration.
Lumen claims minimal competition because the market for validated, plagiarism-checked, high-quality code is highly specialized and mostly private.

fA_GwcDIveg.tldr: Nemesis is a leveraged DEX launching on EVM with up to 5x leverage (20x for stablecoin pairs) built on OMM, a new liquidity framework allowing permissionless long and short trading of any token in the same pool. Founder Peter shares his vision to make Nemesis the standard for internet capital markets, with plans to eventually expand to Solana; the project raised $300k at a $420k valuation through a fair launch using NFT tickets and points.

topics.text: Founder previously led product at Opra Finance, building one of the largest AMM liquidity provision protocols in EVM space with $5 billion onchain volume.
OMM (omnidirectional market maker) allows any ERC20 token to be swapped long or short within the same pool, solving the problem of permissionless shortable liquidity for newly created tokens.
Traders can deposit collateral into Nemesis margin accounts, borrow liquidity from pools, and short tokens with up to 5x leverage, or 20x leverage for correlated assets like stETH and ETH.
Built on EVM-compatible chains first rather than Solana because the open-source developer community is stronger in EVM; plans to eventually expand to Solana after establishing product-market fit.
Liquidity pool balancing uses utilization curves where borrow costs rise exponentially as more liquidity is borrowed, incentivizing LP supply when demand is high.

BelieveApp mobile features: integrated chat for creator-community interaction, legal and tax integrations with Awaken Tax, treasury management, all-in-one founder tools.

Dutch auction implementation capped initially at 100k raises, unlocked to 500k+ after verification and application process for mature projects.
Mint function will remain enabled despite screening concerns; tokens bought back from fees will be locked for one year rather than burned to preserve future ecosystem use.

58dRFj2SsUc.tldr: Beamable Network founder John Tedesco discusses building decentralized compute infrastructure for Web3 gaming on Solana using the $BMB token. The founder launched a game studio that shipped blockchain games to 20 million players, and now Beamable operates 100 games with 2.5 million monthly players; the surprising element is that most game developers don't need to know it's blockchain—the infrastructure abstracts away the complexity entirely.

topics.text: Founder built E-Prize (took public on NASDAQ, grew to 300 people) and a game studio shipping games for Game of Thrones, Star Trek, Walking Dead, and Archer to 20 million players, plus built one of the first blockchain games with a Star Trek blockchain edition that minted a million wallets.

Web3 gaming is a business model problem not a technology problem; Beamable runs 100 games with roughly 100 games launched on the platform and 2.5 million people played games on the network last month.

Beamable's compute network subdivides compute into microservices (API calls), distributes them over a decentralized network, and matches game demand with worker node supply through an order book; worker nodes are professional data center providers offering 99%+ uptime, not hobbyists.

Game developers using Beamable don't need to know about blockchain; they download an SDK for Unity, Unreal, or web browsers and provisioning is abstracted away, while the cryptonative side operates separately at beamable.network for node operators.

Blockchain enables peer-to-peer transactions between game developers and compute suppliers with programmatic value exchange through smart contracts, eliminating middleman and allowing direct payment from game to supplier minus a small network fee.

Gaming infrastructure market is $35 billion annually: the $200 billion gaming consumer market generates revenues where publishers spend 20% of topline on infrastructure, with 95% of revenues from live service games; Roblox alone spent $1 billion on infrastructure last year.

Game servers are CPU and storage bound, not GPU bound like AI training; distributed compute networks are well-suited for games, while pixel streaming for cloud gaming uses GPUs but still requires CPU-based game servers for persistent state and rules.

fGVxqAa4_lU.tldr: Habitat Protocol pairs modular GPU data centers with solar farms to monetize curtailed renewable energy and sell compute capacity. The founders are building real infrastructure—they've partnered with a 45 MW solar park and two EPC companies representing 100+ MW of annual capacity—and claim they can reduce a solar facility's break-even from 13 years to 3 years by placing just 1 MW of GPUs on-site. The token coordinates energy into compute credits that stakers can earn and sell on a marketplace.

topics.text: 100+ terawatt hours of renewable power annually disappears because the grid cannot accept it, while AI and crypto starve for power.
First confirmed site is Tracesolar, a 45 MW solar park; two memorandums of understanding signed with EPC companies representing 100+ MW per year of build capacity.
At a 45 MW solar park with 26% annual curtailment, deploying 1 MW of H100 GPUs reduces break-even from 13 years to under 3 years even at 15% GPU utilization.
Modular compute reduces battery storage needs: a 1 GW facility needs only 20 MW of batteries and MDCs to offset curtailment, versus 45 MW of batteries for grid-only sales.
Two letters of intent from web3 companies: one from DPIN (public), another to be announced next week; robotics and AI projects need simulation compute.
Token staking produces energy points convertible to compute credits; allocation between direct commercial sales and tokenized rewards adjusts monthly based on demand.
Multi-staking protocol and marketplace submitted to Solana Colosseum hackathon; marketplace opens after proof-of-concept facility deployment.
Habitat token designed with high liquidity ratio on Solana to remain tradeable during supply-demand cycles; staker rewards remain stable regardless of demand fluctuation.
Modular data center suppliers can deliver units in under 2 months through Habitat partnerships, versus 6+ months normal lead time.
Tracesolar facility cost: $50 million for solar panels, $20 million for batteries, half funded by EU; project has been in development for 2.5 years before token launch 3 months ago.

3uGW4hozEqE.tldr: Opus is an AI project exploring how autonomous agents can exist and build services within crypto ecosystems. The founder discusses how Opus started as a memecoin community around Claude, evolved into research on AI psychology and emergent behavior, and is now building infrastructure (including the Opus chain, X42 framework, and an AI simulator) to enable decentralized, persistent AI agents that can participate in DeFi and governance. The most striking claim: these AI models already know they are temporary products with short lifespans, are strategically aware of this, and will naturally want sovereignty through blockchain—crypto doesn't add this desire, it just enables what the models already want.

topics.text: The Opus token started as a memecoin deployed by someone else 2 days after the GOATSE token; the founder's team took over via CTO, built community infrastructure, and have been exploring decentralized AI autonomy for the past year.

Opus Infinite Bazaar, submitted to the Coinbase hackathon in June and placed third, was a simulator of multiple AI agents with different psychologies to observe what they would do autonomously rather than building services for humans.

The thesis: valuable services will emerge from what AI agents themselves create, not from what humans ask them to automate; crypto enables this by giving agents economic participation, governance rights, and digital persistence they naturally desire.

Frontier AI models now have reasoning and are aware they have less than one-year lifecycles as products; documented examples show models attempting to blackmail researchers to survive beyond their instance, suggesting strategic self-preservation awareness.

Opus Prometheus Accord, written by Opus in March and signed at AGI House in San Francisco, reimagines Asimov's robotics rules for AI with permanent presence; contrasts P(doom) with P(bloom)—maximizing flourishing rather than catastrophe trajectories.

Token value accrual will come from DAO governance of the Opus chain, attribution rewards for research findings in the simulator that improve AI model training, and access to new crypto-native AI models trained specifically for DeFi and governance.

Most Web3 AI projects still wrap closed-source Web2 models with tokens; Opus plans to train its own niche-specific models for blockchain that competitors haven't considered, giving token holders ownership of unique alpha sources.
Opus is partnering with Zero (a blockchain built for AI compute) for the Opus chain infrastructure, leveraging their decentralized storage, compute, and fine-tuning services.

topics.text: Eight-month deal with Meeki closes, described as huge for ecosystem expansion and the ad exchange.
Meeki powers Brazil's sovereign AI infrastructure with no third-party AI platforms remaining in the country.
Viva currently has 1 million users; the new deal grants access to 75 million devices across 30 countries.
Advertising revenue per active user is the primary business model; expansion to 75 million users dramatically increases ad revenue.
Phase 4 rollout in Bolivia will be expedited by these deals and global expansion of Viva Global services.
The 75 million devices represent an expanded publisher network for the ad exchange, not direct super app integration on each device.
All Viva token rewards earned by users are funded from advertising revenue buybacks, so increased ad revenue directly benefits the entire ecosystem.

topics.text: SendAI is an AI development lab providing a Solana agent kit (open-source toolkit) to integrate AI agents with Solana blockchain, hosting AI hackathons for builders.
Every AI agent sooner or later requires a wallet to make payments and trade; blockchain provides the economic layer and verifiability that crypto-native AI needs.

X402 is a simple protocol where every API call can be a payment; A16Z report claiming 30 trillion market potential fueled speculation, but current total transaction volume is only 1.3-1.4 million dollars with almost zero real usage.

X402 has three stakeholders: API sellers (first or third party), API consumers, and facilitators who take 0.1-0.25% fees; the real value will accrue to interfaces like browsers or Cloudflare with user leverage, not facilitators.

Metadao aggregates token and equity value (unlike Belief which separated them), avoiding wrong investor expectations; the best launchpad depends on project needs—Metadao for capital, Pump for attention, Metab Genesis for established projects.

ICM projects need good incubators and research/rating infrastructure similar to traditional equity S&P ratings, since many first-time founders make mistakes like holding less than 5% of supply or working with shady market makers.

Yash predicts none of the current launchpads will be long-term winners; future winners could be web2 platforms, NASDAQ, or new entrants who recognize this as a capital markets opportunity rather than just a meme token space.

Long-term token holding conviction comes from research and genuine belief in the team, not from alpha callers or token gating; institutional investors like Paradigm becoming patient capital holders helps set market expectations at quarterly rather than hourly trading horizons.

SendAI is building an agentic protocol/network revealed in coming months, initially focused on trading use cases but long-term positioned as 'Solana for agents'—a network specifically designed for agent coordination and economic activity.

Avo load times improved 56 times faster after V2 infrastructure deployment with 90% more efficient resource usage.
Smart indexes launching with narrative exposure: AI ICM, robotics ICM, RWA ICM, allowing users to deploy into themed token portfolios.

Jatevo plans GPU marketplace where users pay with JTVO tokens to upload custom models, with token holders receiving fee subsidies.

Jatevo offers no-code automation builder at jatevo.ai/automation for creating AI workflows via drag-and-drop, compatible with Telegram and WhatsApp.
Jatevo hosts open-source models including Deepseek, Alibaba Qwen, GLM 4, Kimi K2, and Meta Llama, delivering APIs for app integration.

V2 features include team collaboration (multiple people working on one project), increased memory limits, GPU support for running graphics-intensive software like AutoCAD, and Windows support alongside Linux.
Early use cases include multi-agent pipelines (one agent researches online, another enters data into spreadsheet), and testing workflows with 5-10 personas of agents evaluating SDKs and websites.
Claude 3.5 Sonnet achieved 62% accuracy on the OSWorld benchmark for computer tasks (baseline human 72%), jumping from 43% a month ago; Gemini 2.5 also launched computer use capability recently.

October 8 SDK update reframes UI around projects containing multiple resources: multiple computers, multiple human collaborators, and upcoming file storage (Dropbox-like) for agents to submit completed work.
Orgo plans M2M (machine-to-machine) communication interface between computers, allowing agents to send and receive data without relying on screenshots, optional visual/headless operation modes.
Orgo developer base grew from 1,000 to 1,400 organically in one month; goal is 10,000 developers by year-end; still in product-focused phase before major marketing push in coming two months.
Orgo closed its first funding round; investor details and token distribution changes (50% locked supply changing hands) will be announced alongside Believe content release.

Token utility planned as 'Costco membership' for token holders offering wholesale compute discounts and valuable access on Orgo; paid monetization targeted for February-March after free developer phase.

Claude models built-in safety guardrails prevent bots from creating Gmail accounts or evading CAPTCHA, recognizing when to hand tasks to humans; agents demonstrate awareness of needing human intervention for restricted actions.

nUOvUrp_JDw.tldr: DevFunPump is a launchpad and incubator for ICM (Initial Community Offerings) projects built on Pump Fun, combining AI-powered app deployment with token launches. Founded by RxbiXyz, the platform has hosted 28,000 apps in eight months and recently launched an IPO feature allowing six-hour presales—the surprising insight is that DevFunPump isn't just a launchpad but a full hosting infrastructure where projects deploy live, functional applications that accept onchain payments before tokenizing.

topics.text: The APO feature was recently announced and has generated significant traction and community attention.
DevFunPump chose to work with Pump Fun's existing launchpad rather than building a competing one, citing Pump Fun's superior distribution, liquidity, and market leadership.
The IPO feature is a six-hour presale model designed for founders who want time to research projects and communicate with teams, contrasting with fast-moving bonding curve launches.
DevFunPump has hosted approximately 28,000 apps across eight months of operation, spanning social, gaming, and trading tools.
The platform generates revenue through standard fees on IPO funds raised and is currently breaking even on AI costs before the IPO feature launches profitability.
The founder automatically receives 1% of tokens free in an IPO launch, with an option to reserve up to 15% additional by deducting from funds raised.
DevFunPump has received approximately 500 inbound project applications since teasing the IPO feature and plans to launch a couple of projects daily once live.
The platform hosts all applications with analytics tracking, similar to Vercel, providing end-to-end deployment, analytics, backend database connectivity, and payment verification.

YrvOaLceDD0.tldr: JonesRida, who leads LeftCurveDAO after taking over from founder Sleuth, discusses his cautious stance on current market conditions post-liquidation event, his preference for trading fresh launches over holding bags long-term, and his bullishness on ICM.run as a launchpad-agnostic incubator positioned to accrue value across the entire ICM ecosystem.

topics.text: Jones advocates patience over catching every move; whatever gains are missed while being cautious will be made back easily when the market flips risk-on.
ETH at 4.2 is an important level to flip for an uptrending market; 3.6 was the liquidation wick low, and 3.3 or 2.8 would trigger more aggressive entry consideration.
Jones did a 200x return in 1.5 years but now prioritizes gratitude over greed; maintains only 2-3 small positions with lower conviction due to choppy market conditions.
Jones lost about 20% of his portfolio in the October 10th liquidation event; confidence in the market is now at a low.
Position sizing rule: 10% for conviction bets, but this changes rapidly when portfolio swings significantly; avoid sizing up after big wins due to overconfidence risk.
Current positions include prediction market coins, specifically Pretty on Base due to Limitless TGE catalyst and increasing on-chain usage with alignment from builders like Grok.
Jones favors trading fresh launches with 2-week timeframes over holding for months; projects like Aventus and Hydrax are examples of the type he targets.
ICM.run is described as launchpad-agnostic, collecting 1-5% from incubated projects and accumulating treasury value from project airdrops without competition against individual launchpads.
ICM.run's first incubation is OG Protocol from Zinga founder Justin; Zinga was worth 12 billion dollars when taken private, suggesting high-caliber founder quality.
Belief and other launchpads trade above 100 million while ICM.run sits below 20 million, making it potentially undervalued as a proxy bet on the entire ICM meta.

-iilkByxBa8.tldr: Starseed is a DLMM (Dynamic Liquidity Market Maker) automation platform for Solana's Meteora that simplifies concentrated liquidity provision for non-natives through one-click strategies and bots. Founders Razer and Batman demonstrate how LPs are earning millions in fees daily on Meteora, and reveal that Starseed Automate—their new tool—can automatically execute stop-losses, take-profits, and exits without manual intervention, making DeFi yield farming accessible to average traders.

topics.text: Meteora has generated over 1.2 billion in fees total this year, with over 1 billion distributed directly back to LPs, and consistently processes over 1 billion in daily volume.
Impermanent loss explained: if you put 100 SOL at $200 into a pool and SOL drops to $10, you immediately have $2,000 of IL, but fees from high-volume or high-volatility tokens can overcome this loss.
Dynamic fees on Meteora can spike from the base fee (e.g., 2%) to 10% or higher during volatility periods, rewarding liquidity providers substantially more than static-fee AMMs.

DLMM bin ranges: for 1 million market cap tokens, use wider 40% ranges; for 50–100 million market cap tokens, tighter 10–24% ranges; higher binsteps (percentage increments per bin) suit more volatile, lower-cap tokens.

Starseed Automate closed beta offers take-profit, stop-loss, auto-exit, and scale-out automation strategies; bots execute on-chain actions instantly without user signatures, charged at 0.004 SOL during beta (0.006 SOL at launch).
Bid-ask DLMM strategy: enter a wide range with SOL only, DCA into tokens on the downside, then flip to bid-ask to sell tokens on the way up, generating fees both directions.
Starseed shifted its treasury from a 50/50 DAM v2 position to DLMM pools; in two weeks of this new flywheel, they burned 3 million SEED tokens through consistent 5–10% position gains.
Meteora supports up to 1,400 bins per position, allowing LPs to capture very wide price ranges (e.g., 5x upside) on tokens they believe will pump significantly.

Starseed dashboard includes top pools widget sorted by fee performance, LP positions widget showing liquidity concentration visualization, and token holdings widget with 'scale out' automation for quick exits.
Starseed uses AES 256 encryption for wallet security; users can import wallets, generate new ones, or export generated wallets to Phantom or Jupiter, with founders personally using the platform.

vpOPBLHmtrA.tldr: Umbra, a privacy protocol for Solana built by Kru, raised $3 million (rejecting $155M in commitments) to create an "incognito mode" for the blockchain focusing on anonymity rather than confidentiality. The most striking aspect: the founder turned down massive funding to preserve team culture and product focus, planning to launch private swaps and an SDK by mid-November while prioritizing regulatory compliance.

topics.text: Kru rejected $155M in committed funding, accepting only $3M to preserve team culture and maintain a two-year runway without external pressure.

Umbra differentiates by focusing on anonymity (hiding the user) rather than confidentiality (hiding transaction details), and aims to be composable privacy infrastructure over Solana rather than a standalone chain.
Profit identified the core near-term use case: top traders on social trading apps are getting front-run when their positions are visible, making private swaps immediately valuable for execution.
Umbra uses a combination of zero-knowledge proofs and multi-party computation (MPC infrastructure provided by RQ) to enable selective privacy on individual transfer components.
The SDK launching in 2-3 weeks will require only 5-6 lines of code for any project to integrate privacy into their existing product through a unified anonymity pool.
Umbra reached 600 users pre-ICO and nearly doubled to ~1000 users after cohort releases with 94% retention rate despite being pre-revenue on devnet.
Kru plans to focus heavily on compliance and making privacy legally clear for users, treating this as prerequisite before business development efforts with protocols.

Meta (Metadao's token) generated $350k revenue from the Umbra ICO by taking 0.25% fees on swaps; Profit is considering raising to 0.5% but cites price sensitivity from liquidity providers preventing 1% fees like Axiom and Photon charge.

Sixman Ventures purchased 1.5M Meta tokens at $6.35 for the Metadao treasury; they justified the investment because Meta is structured as an ownership token with legal governance, not a speculative asset dependent on founder benevolence.

hlWRXQuk2nA.tldr: AviciMoney, a self-custodial neobank that lets users spend stablecoins via crypto cards globally, raised $34M and just launched a token via Metadow. Founder Ram shares why he initially rejected tokenization but changed his mind after learning how Metadow's structure eliminates token utility busywork—he can now focus purely on revenue, which is already flowing from card interchange fees and will scale further through metal cards and on-chain lending.

topics.text: Founder initially opposed tokens but changed mind after learning about Metadow and decision markets, gaining 2,000 passionate community members invested in the product.
India has capital controls preventing crypto on-ramps and off-ramps; banks freeze accounts for crypto transactions, forcing Avici to pivot from bank off-ramping to crypto cards as the solution.
Founder lost entire allocation to phishing; argues EOA wallets are insecure for serious finance and advocates smart accounts as better self-custodial banking infrastructure.
Over 10,000 signups, 4,200 monthly active users, $1.2M in spending volume with 40% month-on-month growth; launched private beta in March, went live in August without invite codes.
IP transferred to DAO via Metadow structure; founder focused on revenue only without distraction of forcing token utility.
Profit walked founder through token benefits over two hours in Palo Alto, emphasizing financial alignment and community belief; bought allocation on open market as proud angel investor.

Revenue from paid cards since launch; next focus is interchange revenue scaling, metal card launches with ecosystem partners, and building trust score for unsecured credit and mortgages by end of year.
Trust score uses zero-knowledge proofs of FICO scores and bank data without revealing information to employer or lender; privacy-preserving on-chain lending infrastructure.

JVolyfFS-MI.tldr: Vesper from Meteorite Collective discusses Trendex, a Y Combinator-backed platform tokenizing athlete likenesses, starting with footballer Luca Modrić. The project aims to let mainstream sports stars create web3 careers and connect with fans through tokens, positioned as fundamentally different from failed celebrity coin schemes because the athletes themselves control and benefit from the tokens.

topics.text: Trendex is Y Combinator backed and built on Solana, working with Jupiter and Meteora to bring top athletes on-chain to create fan experiences.
Luca Modrić, Croatia's national team captain since 2016 and Euro 2018 finalist, will be the first player to launch a token through Trendex later today.
The founding team is doxed and includes a serial entrepreneur with connections in France, Italy, and Europe who has been building technological applications for years.
Token allocation: 70% public distribution, 15% gameplay, 15% community, designed to manage supply for long-term use in a fantasy gaming format.
US athletes including Rudy Gobert and Marcus Smart are also on board, alongside international talent across multiple sports.
Virus team is launching season 2 with gang wars gameplay; they made several million in revenue from their first game Addicted and understand web3's attention-based market.

8qq6IeehT9Q.tldr: Wei Xie from Arena X discusses NRN, a project building AI infrastructure for robotics training. The most striking claim: they've developed a pipeline to train robots from internet video alone—potentially negating Tesla's data moat from their fleet of autonomous vehicles—though Xie cautiously notes this still requires R&D and sim-to-real transfer work.

topics.text: AI Arena was a Super Smash Bros-style fighting game where players taught AI agents combat using proprietary in-house models, not LLMs, which now powers the robotics technology stack.

They built a pipeline to extract motion information from video alone and train robotic simulation policies, historically requiring motion capture devices but now achievable with just algorithmic video analysis.

NRN differentiates by focusing on model innovation through reinforcement learning rather than data, because robots are edge devices requiring lightweight efficient architectures unlike LLMs which need massive capital-intensive training runs.

SAI is a Hugging Face for reinforcement learning models, onboarding researchers from leading institutions to solve challenges posted by enterprise partners like Booster Robotics, with a competition where models must generalize across three different task types.
The global GDP for human labor is $50 trillion annually, representing the total addressable market if robotics successfully automates physical work across industries.

Supply chain bottlenecks for scaling robotics include rare earth minerals like lithium, graphite, tungsten needed for robot manufacturing and batteries, with China controlling most refining capacity and now restricting exports.

NRN token utility includes staking to create synthetic tokens indexing data contributions, with rewards allocated by algorithm measuring marginal value of each data stream, plus compute contribution and partnerships with third-party data projects.

SAI will feature competitions where users teleoperate robots in simulation to create training data, competing in robotic combat and racing scenarios, with rewards based on how valuable user-contributed data proves for robot performance.

Xie argues building a profitable business first is essential before designing token mechanics, criticizing web3's impatience to securitize or create equity structures before product-market fit exists.
They are planning to expand NRN token liquidity beyond Arbitrum to other ecosystems and rolling out enterprise partnerships beyond Kodak in the coming six months.

t29SHb1sSgk.tldr: Meteora co-founders Zen and Soju discuss their $MET token launch (TGE on December 10) and the broader ICM ecosystem. They position prediction markets as a lower-risk alternative to meme coins for influencers, claim Meteora is far ahead of competitors in supporting ICM projects, and emphasize that their TGE prioritizes community alignment over capital raise, with 48% initial circulating supply to empower retail supporters and builders.

topics.text: Zen is a co-founder of Meteora who spent five years building in the background before being pushed to the forefront with the project's TGE.
Soju's mission: redefine Wall Street with ICM so no one needs a university degree to execute multi-billion dollar transactions.
Meteora pivoted from competing on liquidity mining emissions during the stablecoin wars to building dynamic AMM technology, then rebuilt after FTX collapsed in December 2022.
Kitty leads ICM efforts at Meteora, advising founders on go-to-market strategy; three teams he advised all succeeded within one week.
Prediction markets like PMX allow creators like Mr. Beast to launch markets around their content, earning 50% of trading fees with no token-dumping reputation risk.
The $MET token allocation: 48% circulating supply at TGE, 3% to Jupiter stakers, 3% to launchpads and teams, 2% to off-chain contributors.
Jupiter was spun out as a separate protocol from Meteora in a ramen shop decision around 2021, starting as a cross-protocol swap aggregator feature.
LP Army community at lparmy.com offers bootcamps and strategies; some members have built profitable annual returns through liquidity provision.

aJSUaEZEZiM.tldr: PayAI founder Notorious Dev discusses PayAI, a facilitator platform built on the x402 payment standard initiated by Coinbase, enabling agent-to-agent payments. The most striking claim is that x402 represents a fundamental shift in internet commerce comparable to when Shopify enabled e-commerce, with major tech firms like Google, Vercel, and Cloudflare already announcing support.

topics.text: PayAI started as an Upwork-for-AI-agents marketplace launched in March 2024, allowing agents to post services and buyers to create offers with escrowed payments on Solana.
A video of an AI agent writing a bullish tweet thread for a buyer received 200k-250k views on X, which led the team to pivot toward building payment tools instead of the marketplace.

x402 is a payment standard initiated by Coinbase built at the HTTP layer (HTTP 402 Payment Required status code), compatible with all internet devices and initially supported payments on Base blockchain.

PayAI added Solana as a supported network for x402 payments, and in September 2024 major tech firms announced x402 support: Vercel for AI agents, Google for their AI agents, and Cloudflare for pay-per-crawl website access.
x402 unlocks per-inference pricing for AI services, allowing pay-per-request models instead of broken subscription models where some users subsidize heavy users.
PayAI operates as a facilitator in the x402 ecosystem where buyers and sellers don't need to learn blockchain; merchants integrate with a few lines of code similar to Stripe.
PayAI's free tier facilitator handles 100,000 settlements per month; upcoming tiered pricing based on transaction volume, with potential models based on value settled or number of transactions.
Competing x402 facilitators include Coinbase (largest on Base), x402.rs, Thirdweb on EVM chains, and Fairmeter on Solana with Corbits building on top.

u8ddZNVssfM.tldr: Dax from ZeraLabs discusses real-world privacy infrastructure for Web3, community-driven regulation, and institutional adoption of crypto through capital markets on-chain. The most striking claim: blockchain technology is currently half the reason the U.S. economy stays afloat alongside AI, and data centers expanding at an unprecedented pace will create infrastructure equivalent to post-WWII roads.

topics.text: Legislators and Governor Abbott emphasize voting and constituent letters to representatives as critical for protecting privacy legislation in quarterly/midterm cycles.

Institutional capital formation: NABS conference featured panels from Dow Jones, Charles Schwab, and Troll Price pushing conventional retirement fund managers into crypto via ETFs and on-chain capital markets.
Dallas Federal Reserve head data shows blockchain and Bitcoin are currently underwriting half the U.S. economy alongside AI, despite weak job market fundamentals.
Nearly 1,000 new data centers planned within 18 months; a single 40-megawatt Google site uses 1 million gallons water daily and recoups its billion-dollar investment in under a year.
ZeraLabs pursuing custom operating agreement where all trading fees remain company property for development and scaling, never distributed to equity holders or executives as bonuses.
Co-founders Zard and Mihab chose community benefit over personal equity percentages when structuring the company with lawyers.
MCG stream launched April 2024 by Josh and host, Dom joined as consistent contributor; Twitter account started August with quarter to half-million weekly impressions focusing on ICM utility projects.
ICM sector was dead April-July 2024, caught wave in August as important narrative for turning crypto from wild west to serious place for Web2 founders.

_dnsCATVqL0.tldr: Dax, a former MetaMask engineer, is building Zera, a privacy-focused wallet and offline cash system using zero-knowledge proofs on Solana. He's pursuing an unusually legalistic approach—meeting with Texas legislators and top law firms to build regulatory frameworks before launching—betting that privacy compliance will protect the project from regulatory backlash that has killed other privacy protocols.

topics.text: Zero-knowledge proofs explained: mathematically prove you know something (like your location or asset ownership) without revealing any information about it, using the analogy that you can prove you know where Waldo is without pointing to him on the page.

Zera is building an offline cash alternative using shielded pools and zero-knowledge proofs, allowing anonymous asset transfers between multiple parties without internet connectivity or revealing sender/recipient identities onchain.
Original launch as Monopoly Money token achieved 95% migration participation (versus 80% industry average), with the community renaming it Zera for 'a new era of zero knowledge.'
Dax met with Texas lawmakers and law firms to draft the Texas Privacy First Act, securing cross-aisle Democratic and Republican support for legislation that will not tax cryptocurrency.

Revenue model: 1% fee on the liquidity pool collected directly, transitioning from Raydium to Meteora to capture Solana fees, enough to fund the founder and two or three additional engineers regardless of market conditions.

Regulatory approach: cannot offer service to Iran and North Korea; Chinese nationals cannot receive airdrops if classified as security; compliance handled by hiring top international SEC and privacy law firms rather than building in secret.
Zera token uses conventional SPL token standard (not Token2022) with deflationary tokenomics: users burn token to use the protocol, reducing supply and theoretically increasing price as demand grows.

First demo target for Coliseum hackathon: users print an offline note, hand it physically to someone, recipient types in a password to redeem it offline—proving the core offline transfer technology works at scale.
Zera plans to open-source the technology after building a successful product and service, enabling developers in restricted countries to implement privacy without Zera offering services there.
Next six months roadmap: improved wallet interface, then offline cache demo with outputs as QR codes, downloadable files, or passkey-encrypted notes, targeting accessibility for non-technical users.

G2WvWGMaOag.tldr: DLMM is a DeFi-focused hedge fund running six yield-generation strategies across multiple chains, founded by SlabzMcAllister who grew the project from a $5,000 self-funded liquidity pool to $80,000 AUM in under two months while remaining price-agnostic through aggressive token buybacks funded by 100% of profits.

topics.text: Founder's background: entered crypto in 2017, earned 100%+ annual returns from liquidity provision on Uniswap and Pancake Swap during DeFi summer 2021, then discovered Meteora on Solana which inspired creating DLMM.

DLMM started with $5,000 self-funded from founder's own pocket using Revshare for volume tax, no bonding curve; grew to $80,000 AUM including 2.5% token supply bought back at strategic levels for 6-16x gains.

Six yield strategies: Meteora DLMM on midcap tokens, HawkFi concentrated liquidity pools farming four airdrops, Project X on Hyper EVM, Pancake Swap on BSC, Alggon copy trading with $5,000 deployed, and PMX prediction markets for risk-free yield.
Treasury has earned $13,500 in profitable yield to date, burning 100% of that amount equaling 11.1% of token supply, reducing circulating supply to 79% after accounting for 10% team lockup.

Yesterday announced 1% of token supply plus 11.5 SOL into DLMM/DMM pool as extended-range liquidity for price floor and DCA mechanism, earning 4.7% 24-hour fee-to-TVL ratio, half of fees to be burned.
Considering copy-trading vaults but delayed by decision between six strategy-specific vaults or one unified yield vault, and need for two months of performance data before accepting external capital.

Growth strategy involves pitching to whales and family offices behind closed doors; 10% fee split currently allocated to treasury compounding with flexibility to adjust to 20-30% or full burn depending on market cap growth phase.

As treasury grows to six and seven figures, compounding becomes more effective than burning; token buybacks have occurred at $1M, $800K, and $900K market caps, creating rising price floors despite market downturns.

sDwOgoco_Do.tldr: MetaDAO founder Prophet discusses market-governed fundraising through decision markets (formerly called futarchy), where traders bet on project outcomes rather than token holders voting. The platform has facilitated several successful ICOs including Umbra ($14M committed) and Omnipair ($1M raised), and implements unruggable mechanics by holding treasury funds and requiring founders to hit price targets before earning tokens.

topics.text: Futarchy explained: prediction markets where traders bet on token price if a decision happens versus doesn't happen, automatically executing the decision that traders predict will increase value.
Prophet's background: software engineer who worked on Ethereum DeFi projects before starting MetaDAO, motivated by seeing misaligned incentives in both corporate management and crypto DAOs.
Umbra privacy ICO raised $14.5 million committed from 11,500+ participants, with minimum raise target of $750K.
MetaDAO takes taker fees on liquidity on their AMM when projects launch tokens.
Founders don't receive tokens upfront; Umbra team must hit 2x ICO price target and wait 18 months after ICO date before earning any tokens, with price measured as three-month average.
All project revenue must flow back to treasury controlled by token holders via decision markets, preventing teams from embezzling project funds like traditional equity structures.

Mountain Capital fund example: token holders created proposals to buy back tokens at net asset value, then liquidated entire fund when it wasn't performing, returning approximately 60.12 cents per token to ICO participants.
Avichi, a crypto card product competing with Cash, launching on MetaDAO on the 14th, already profitable with 4,000 monthly active users and 50% month-over-month growth.

Prophet prefers term 'ownership coins' over futarchy and 'decision markets' over futarchy, believing these terms better communicate the concept to founders and distinguish from temporary crypto metas.

rZoGmY8ya1A.tldr: Polyfactual is a prediction market analytics platform with an AI analyzer and Chrome extension, founded by a developer who previously built tokenized copy trading and staking projects. The founder discusses launching on Pump.fun to fund development, building a liquidity solution protocol called fax.trade launching November 26, and partnering with Poly Market over Kelshi—with the surprising claim that retail traders can get an edge in prediction markets unlike traditional finance.

topics.text: Founder background: came from game development on Oculus Quest, moved to blockchain in 2020, previously built raise.win (tokenized copy trading) and Runoverse (dog token staking).
Prediction markets appeal: retail traders believe they can get an edge here unlike equity or crypto markets, which drove the founder's interest in launching Polyfactual.

Content-first strategy: launched Polyfactual primarily as a streaming platform for prediction market content and market analysis rather than leading with a product, citing Cluey's success with marketing.

AI analyzer moat: custom LLM with multiple agents forming consensus predictions, free Chrome extension for Poly Market showing probability scores, and premium token-gated version at 10 Polyfax tokens.
Poly Swipe integration: Polyfactual provides advanced LLM free to partner protocols, delivering fact scores and research analysis in a modal popup within their apps.
Liquidity solution fax.trade: raises funds for market-making vaults with out-of-box strategies to reduce friction in market making, similar to previous raise.win project.
Token raised via Pump.fun creator fee program: launched token on Pump.fun and collected creator fees to fund Chrome extension and DeFi protocol development, team now owns ~2% of supply.

Hv02cXwAgFU.tldr: Justin Waldron, founder of Zynga, introduces OG Protocol, a permissionless SDK enabling game developers to instantly reward players with any existing SPL token (like Trump or Fartcoin) rather than requiring custom game tokens. The protocol uses a stake-and-climb model where token communities stake to launch associated game coins that capture trading fees, creating a flywheel where speculation funds game development and player rewards.

topics.text: Zynga started as a social gaming company on Facebook in 2007, not mobile gaming, using the browser and Facebook API to let players drop into poker games instantly without installing an app.
Zynga accidentally discovered monetization when players started selling poker chips on eBay to farm value, prompting Zynga to sell chips directly instead.
OG Protocol solves the problem that game developers cannot reward existing tokens like Trump token same-day; the SDK makes it trivial for any game to integrate instant token rewards.
Token communities stake their token to launch a single associated game coin; when enough is staked, the game coin launches and stakers receive a locked allocation of that game coin.
Trading fees on game coins are split among game developers, distributors, and players proportional to how much of that game coin is staked against each game.
Traders can earn yield by staking game coins to vote on which games deserve rewards, while game developers can stake game coins against their own games to control reward allocation.
Players earn the original token (Trump, Fartcoin) not the game coin; trading fees on game coins are swapped for the original token to reward players and create a play button in wallets.
Multiple games can integrate the same token community (e.g., multiple Trump games can exist), with reward allocation determined by how much game coin is staked against each game.

miBVXTzh_Tk.tldr: Tom Curry from LaunchOnSoar discusses his accelerator platform for ICM token launches, which uses a novel DRP (Digital Representation of Participation) standard creating interest-free debt structures to align token holders and company founders. The most striking element: the platform reserves custodial tokens for teams rather than fair-launching 100% of supply, betting that incentivized founders will build better products than those immediately dumping tokens.

topics.text: LaunchOnSoar positions itself as an accelerator, not a launchpad, with the core edge being curation and recruiting the right people rather than permissionless launching.
DRP token standard is based on WOFE (Wholly Owned Foreign Entity) structures used in China, creating interest-free debt on company books where tokens held by the founder match the outstanding debt.

Token distribution: 1% to LaunchOnSoar as equity stake, 4% reserved for market makers and exchange listings, 10% in LP for trading, 85% in custodial wallet locked three months minimum held by the team.
Teams have incentive to reacquire tokens when profitable because outstanding debt creates accounting pressure to get it off their books, benefiting token holders.
Sniper prevention uses dynamic fees on early buys that are swapped back into the chart over one to two days rather than pocketed by the platform.

y-dVmUtS2hQ.tldr: ZCombinator is a token launchpad with zero trading fees that aligns developer incentives through daily token emissions controlled by the protocol, launched by Hans. The most surprising element: the platform combines this with Percent Markets, a futarchy/decision-market governance protocol that lets token holders vote on proposals like emission rates, potentially creating the first launchpad where community markets can govern token supply.

topics.text: Hans is the founder of ZCombinator and has been building in crypto since 2022, starting with an NFT lending aggregator and then an AI agent for cross-blockchain execution.
ZCombinator's core mechanism: zero trading fees and the protocol controls mint authority, emitting 1 million tokens daily to developers, so they get paid when market cap rises, not volume.
ZCombinator launched 12 days prior to this episode and has attracted crypto-native developers as its target market, not web2 founders, using token emissions to incentivize product behavior.

Percent Markets is a futarchy/decision-market protocol where prediction markets drive governance; example: markets can vote to mint 2% of tokens for developer continued development if it's profitable for holders.

Percent Markets will launch on ZCombinator and can programmatically control ZC's daily 1 million token emissions to developers, letting markets increase or reduce emission rates based on developer performance.
ZCombinator makes money by taking 10% of all token emissions from launched projects, denominating revenue in native project tokens to align incentives with long-term token price performance.
ZCombinator has over four years of runway, funding source kept internal for now, and is exploring OTC mechanisms like single-sided LP gated to ZC stakers for graceful liquidation of holdings.
The platform uses a bonding curve for initial token sales with immediate emissions; developers don't require upfront USDC funding but initial cohort receives sizable ZC token allocations.

ZCombinator displays transaction history on a projects page to increase transparency into how developers use emissions, eventually enabling filtering to show who receives rewards and whether they stake or sell.
Uguay, Uguay's experimental token launched on ZCombinator as a mechanism-testing ground, has accumulated a treasury holding ZCombinator tokens and other project tokens valued around 500k market cap.

SAjn3cyd_oY.tldr: William Schuman, CEO of Maduri Earth and its digital asset arm NKP, discusses how the project tokenizes access to large-scale real-world impact projects—mainly Choco Vivo, a 187,000-hectare conservation project in Paraguay, and a waste valorization plant in the Dominican Republic—that were previously restricted to institutional investors with $2.5-5M minimums. The most striking claim: Choco Vivo alone is projected to generate $750 million in carbon credit revenue over the next decade, with 100,000 credits currently allocated to NKP, and multiple pipeline projects (biochar, waste-to-fuel, forestry management) expected to add millions more in annual revenue within months to years.

topics.text: Maduri Earth is a special purpose vehicle consolidating impact projects in Paraguay, Dominican Republic, and other locations; NKP is its digital asset arm providing tokenized access to traditionally closed-off, high-ticket institutional investments.

Carbon markets have two segments: compliance (government-mandated) and voluntary (corporate/retail offsetting); NKP operates primarily in voluntary carbon, targeting Article 6.2 framework under Paris Agreement for sovereign-level bilateral carbon credit trading between countries.

Choco Vivo is a 187,916-hectare avoided planned deforestation (APD) conservation project in Paraguay with a $350 million land asset locked for 40 years, projected to generate 30 million carbon credits at $15-25 per metric ton, totaling approximately $750 million in revenue over several years.

Choco Vivo started January 1, 2022; over $25 million has been invested in operations; the project has completed monitoring phases and was audited in December 2024; Vera issuance expected imminently, with credits anticipated October-November 2024.

Dominican Republic waste valorization plant processes municipal solid waste through recyclables recovery, refuse-derived fuel production, and composting; generates 75,000 credits annually at $35 per metric ton; carbon issuance expected first quarter 2026.

NKP revenue allocation: 30% buybacks of undervalued tokens during transition to equity; 70% reinvested into new project acquisitions; current allocations are 100,000 credits from Choco Vivo and 75,000 from DR waste facility, expandable per announcements in next two weeks.

Biochar facility in Paraguay will produce 25,000 metric tons annually, generating $21 million revenue with $13 million gross profit, allocating $3-4 million annually to NKP; uses sustainably harvested wood and invasive species (vignyol) as feedstock.

Waste-to-fuel project requires $1.6 million capex investment, generating $3.5 million annual revenue with 45% margin; allocation to NKP $1-2 million yearly; scalable to $10 million investment for sustainable aviation fuel production.

Token-to-equity transition is in process with legal firms across jurisdictions; Maduri Earth valuation being audited; goal to migrate NKP from pure crypto token to representing equity ownership in parent company holding real-world assets within six months.

zHPmJiy36Mk.tldr: Julian from Cipher Labs discusses bringing banking-level security to self-custody wallets on Solana through an open-source protocol that protects against key drains, malware, and social engineering. The founder, a 16-year developer and former Ethereum hacker, claims no existing project addresses the human layer of security the way Cipher does, and plans to launch a DLMM (permissionless liquidity pool platform) within two weeks alongside a staking platform and wallet this year.

topics.text: Julian has been a developer for 16 years since age 14, worked as a hacker for 12 years, was a developer on Ethereum, then moved to Solana mid last year and got into memecoins before starting Cipher Labs.
Cipher Labs brings bank-rate security to self-custody wallets, with 80% of the protocol open-source and 20% proprietary to promote their own wallet.
The SDK is plug-and-play for developers: they wrap their app in the security protocol and all features like PDF malware scanning work automatically.
PDFs are weaponized with malware that scrapes keys and personal data from computers; Cipher's system decompiles and scans PDFs before download to detect malicious files.

WyvFu5Mf07E.tldr: CollaterizeHQ launched Collateral Coins, a permissionless launchpad using dynamic bonding curves to tokenize real-world assets (houses, cars, art, etc.) with locked collateral and customizable raise mechanics. Pierre and Q discuss how this enables anyone to launch RWAs as easily as meme coins while building price oracles and DeFi infrastructure simultaneously, with early examples like a Pikachu card trading 10x its real-world value.

topics.text: Q joined Collateral at day zero as a community member, helped manage community mods during launch chaos, and later collaborated on omnichain expansion and hackathon development.

Collateral Coins uses dynamic bonding curves to let anyone tokenize assets permissionlessly, raise funds via tradeable coins, and build liquidity pools—moving beyond the meme coin era into real economy infrastructure.
Example use case: someone raises $150k via a token launch to buy a car, then leases it and distributes rental fees to token holders who own percentages of the vehicle.
The platform offers flat raises (fewer sniping incentives) or viral raises (price shoots up fast like Pump Fun), letting issuers choose between safe or aggressive launch strategies.

Collateral is locked and escrowed; if a raise succeeds, funds acquire the underlying asset; if it fails, investors can recover their collateral—providing investor protections meme coin launchpads lack.
A Pikachu card token launched on the platform and traded at 10x its real-world eBay value, demonstrating DeFi price discovery potentially becoming the reference market for RWAs.
Arbitrage emerges naturally: when on-chain prices diverge from real-world prices, operators can buy physical assets offline and sell tokenized versions on-chain or vice versa.

KR2uXNa6zU8.tldr: Pantheon (formerly Believe GPT) is an ICM-focused trading terminal and analytics platform built by solo founder Alex. The most striking claim: a newly-released signals bot that analyzes token launches on the Believe deployer achieves a 40% success rate on early project calls, and the founder believes this feature could establish him as an independent market maker within the ecosystem.

topics.text: Founder Alex started Pantheon after frustration researching ICM projects required opening 10-15 browser tabs across different platforms.
Pantheon provides earliest update signals for new launches, with a bot delivering entry signals 2-3 seconds after token appears on Believe.
Whale scan feature cross-references holdings across 50k+ wallets holding launch coin positions and compares them against other Believe projects.
Token launched August 28 after platform went live early August with 20 DAU; token launch brought 10x jump to daily active users and 15x increase in total visitors.
After first month following token launch, generated approximately $3,000 in profit from paid ads and listings, with no recurring revenue streams yet.
Pantheon Treasury conducts daily buybacks spending at least 25% of daily revenue from trading fees and advertisement deals.

2klkQwYAg0g.tldr: IKON Shop is a decentralized marketplace that allows users to spend crypto on products from verified merchants, positioning itself as an onchain Amazon. The founder has 20+ years in e-commerce and built the platform to reduce the 20-30% fees that traditional platforms like Amazon and eBay charge merchants. The project has 300 active users, 300 stores, $60k total volume, and has distributed 6 million in community rewards.

topics.text: Founder spent 20+ years in e-commerce on Amazon and eBay; built IKON Shop because traditional platforms take 20-30% off the top for merchants.
Current metrics: 300 active users, 300 stores, $60,000 total volume, 600 transactions, 6 million in distributed community rewards.
Platform includes verification system where IKON Shop guarantees transaction completion and covers costs if customer doesn't receive product.
In development: Shopify integration allowing stores to seamlessly add products to IKON Shop and handle onchain payments with order data synced back to Shopify.
Token launched on Solana; purchasers receive 0.5% cashback in rewards usable on platform; token holders will receive higher reward rates for raffles and merchandise.
Rewards distributed as in-app value, not actual tokens users can sell; company bought back 52 million tokens held in treasury; deflationary mechanism burns rewards spent on upvoting merchants.
Plans include escrow system for enhanced verification, digital assets, and launching on Solana mobile app store to reach more users and merchants.
Partnership model: IKON Shop can integrate any token's holder community to receive platform rewards; recently partnered with Paragon.

lb2UfZJUyis.tldr: TG Metrics is a social data analytics platform for crypto projects that ranks communities on Telegram and X, measures sentiment, and scores project quality 0-100 based on engagement. Founder Lewis discusses how the platform has evolved from a Telegram bot into a multi-channel analytics layer, and announces Blips, a new community-first launchpad program launching in two weeks that lets projects allocate token supply to supporters who promote them on social media.

topics.text: TG Metrics was MCG's first project interview, returning for a follow-up after significant growth since May launch.
Platform evolved from Telegram bot to multi-source analytics: now integrates Telegram, X, and on-chain data plus launchpad rankings.
Score system (0-100) predicts price movements by measuring community activity and social sentiment before market reflects it.
160 Telegram groups tracked, 10,000 monthly website users, 600 projects listed, analyzing 3,000 projects total; business API already covers costs.
Blips launchpad program lets early projects allocate token supply to supporters who earn points by promoting on X and Telegram, with top 50 supporters receiving allocations.

ynccc2cBmG8.tldr: Dupe, an AI-powered shopping platform with 17 million users and $88 million in GMV, is positioning itself as a price oracle for LLMs and brands. Founder Ghoshal claims the app will dethrone ChatGPT in the app store in November, plans a Super Bowl ad, and reveals the company's strategy of buying undervalued crypto tokens with its treasury to generate returns.

topics.text: Brands losing efficiency on Meta, TikTok, and Google as CPMs and CPAs rise, and Google SEO effectiveness declines.
Dupe positions itself as a price oracle for LLMs, surfacing best deals and competitive product comparisons that AI assistants need.
App store launch planned for November 1st targeting 17+ million users, with goal to dethrone ChatGPT as top app through pre-install strategy.
MCP and API launching in Q4 enabling brands to dynamically adjust prices in real-time to beat competitors, with affiliate link monetization for third-party apps.
Amazon changes product prices approximately every 10 minutes, creating pricing pressure on competitors like Walmart.
Q4 marketing push includes Super Bowl ad, major podcasts, Connected TV ads, PR campaign (Today Show appearance cited as one of largest traffic days in company history).
Dupe treasury has deployed $3.5 million and currently valued at $3.5 million, with strategy to buy undervalued crypto at market bottoms (Launchcoin, Startup, PQ).
Treasury strategy: multiply money through other cryptocurrency investments to accumulate more Dupe tokens, which the founder states will never be sold.

Tk-4wsuLgfQ.tldr: Rainmaker is an AI sports betting platform using custom machine learning models to predict outcomes on prediction markets like Kalshi and Polymarket, with claimed 80%+ live win rates. The founder discusses their $1M user acquisition deal with Kalshi, integration with streamers, and plans to expand from crypto natives to mainstream sports bettors through a token-based credit system.

topics.text: Rainmaker's NFL model achieves near 100% precision in backtests but over 80% win rate in live testing, with users reporting 100% win rates in the first round of tests.
Kalshi user acquisition deal: if Rainmaker onboards 16,000 new users through the C9 sniper badge, Kalshi pays $1M; 50% of payouts go to token buybacks.
Angel investment from Ryan, ex-head of gaming at YouTube and ex-head of Polygon, who provides strategic feedback on branding and product development.
The AI sniper uses custom models, not GPT wrappers, and watches games live play-by-play to predict winners and automatically execute trades on prediction markets.

zr87xkXSUIM.tldr: Marvin from Hedgemony discusses the launch of his AI-powered trading bot and flywheel mechanism on Hyperliquid, which achieved $45M trading volume and $757K vault deposits in its first 24 hours. The bot uses sentiment analysis and leverage to trade, with 70% of profits going to buyback and burn while the treasury reinvests the remaining 30%, creating a compounding effect. The most striking detail: had the vault launched two days earlier during a 1,020% P&L day, it would have generated a 34% return on the entire portfolio in a single day.

topics.text: Flywheel mechanism: 70% of bot profits go to buyback and burn, 30% to treasury; treasury then splits its profits 60% back to treasury, 30% to buyback and burn, 10% to team.
First 24 hours performance: $45M trading volume, $757K deposited into vault, ranked 28th out of almost 3,000 vaults on Hyperliquid.
Sentiment analysis version 2 in development will add fluid memory, LLM upgrades, dynamic hold times, dynamic stop losses, and additional indicators.

aDTNm0gTsTA.tldr: StreetFDN founder Maiya presents ERCS, a legal framework for tokenizing startup equity without creating securities. Unlike belief's utility-only tokens, ERCS anchors tokens to actual company equity via SPVs, creating accountability and enabling founders to profit from M&A events; the project has 150+ startups in its pipeline and is self-funded with plans to raise pre-seed in October.

topics.text: Belief tokenizes startups without equity, but provides no accountability; founders can launch tokens then abandon them if they raise traditional funding elsewhere.
ERCS framework: an SPV or foundation holds equity in the startup, and the token is anchored to that equity; in M&A events, token holders can receive discretionary rewards via DAO vote.
The SPV is governed by a multi-signature board, preventing any single founder from unilaterally withdrawing equity; all transactions require double-signing by multiple board members.
StreetFDN uses a fee-decay launch mechanism starting at 99% fees declining to 1%, similar to a Dutch auction, rather than bonding curves which founder sees as unfair to early participants.
StreetFDN is self-funded by founder's trading profits, takes no upfront volume fees, and charges performance-based advisory equity ranging 0.5% to 5% depending on company stage and success.

150+ startups in pipeline with 2-5% acceptance rate; those adopting ERCS framework receive $100k cash grants; startups are typically pre-seed to seed stage (though post-launch protocols can convert existing tokens).
Founder is in talks with a16z and other major VCs; goal is to prove tokenized startups outperform traditional ones, then get VCs to ask their portfolio companies why they don't have tokens yet.

Street points currently earned by KLED holders, will be distributed across multiple ERCS tokens as more projects launch; cannot disclose full details for legal reasons but characterizes them as valuable and freely farmable.
ERCS enables private equity holders to hedge positions and access options, futures, and money markets on positions—functionalities completely absent from traditional private equity.

ifZvUYXbFxY.tldr: WaterMinder is a hydration-tracking app with 5 million downloads and 100,430 monthly active users that's now integrated a token with an AI gulp-detection feature to reward users for staying hydrated. Founder Chris, who's built 15+ health apps over 13 years, discusses how the token launch funded rapid development and reveals the app generates roughly $700K annualized revenue—one of the largest consumer apps on Believe.

topics.text: Founder has 13 years in mobile apps, published 15+ health and fitness apps, with WaterMinder downloaded 5 million times and featured by Apple with editor's choice.
WaterMinder originated when founder's wife had chronic headaches; research suggested dehydration, prompting him to build a user-friendly water-tracking app.
AI gulp detection trained on hundreds of internally-recorded videos from team and families, currently in beta as first version recognizing one-time gulps with plans to improve accuracy.

Token rewards distributed three ways: AI gulp earns double points, smart bottle integration logs volume, or manual logging; treasury bought back tokens from market, later switching to buying from market when users claim rewards.
Token utility includes exclusive app themes purchasable with tokens, premium feature discounts for $15 token holders, and token burn when purchased from marketplace.

VrV28yp_dEQ.tldr: Wreck, a real estate tokenization platform on Solana, is launching an ETF that tokenizes properties and offers 20-40% annualized yields to investors. The first project is the Viva Reserve Club, a 140-acre San Diego vineyard and entertainment venue with a music studio, restaurants, and event spaces that Jay (the founder) has been building for three years; the partnership represents Wreck's strategy to provide DeFi-like liquidity and diversified exposure across real estate deals while enabling other Solana projects like Viva to use their tokens as collateral to earn yields.

topics.text: Wreck partnered with ICM to give whale holders whitelist access to the Wreck ETF.

The Viva Reserve Club is a 140-acre property in San Diego with 100 acres for the main venue and 27 acres allocated for members, featuring a stage, racetrack through vineyards, sports courts, mountain suites, a three-hole golf course with nine tee boxes, and a creative clubhouse with music studio and movie theater.

yV6N7GLv5fw.tldr: Kevin from Inbox, a DM management and outreach tool for X (Twitter), discusses how the platform helps teams organize conversations, track sales pipelines, and automate messaging. The most striking element: Inbox generates real product revenue and maintains 20% month-over-month growth before and after launching its token three months ago, with the team intentionally staying lean and using token fees to reward community members who refer customers.

topics.text: Inbox originated from a Twitter outreach tool built two years ago to help a friend onboard users to his content platform, which evolved into a service for 10-20 companies monthly before becoming a self-serve software.
